answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring nodes to lock capital to validate transactions. Much like the distinct scent of saffron or a solitary willow on a rolling knoll, identity is tied to economic scarcity rather than ephemeral addresses. An attacker seeking to flood the network must acquire a majority of the circulating supply, imposing a prohibitive financial cost that renders the generation of fake identities economically irrational compared to the yield of honest participation.
